# Mariposa Mobile Phlebotomy

> Certified mobile phlebotomy (in-home blood draws) across Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Solano, Sacramento, and the greater San Francisco Bay Area. Booked online, done at your door. Compassionate care, delivered to you.

## Key facts
- Founder / lead phlebotomist: Ellie (Arely Arango Ramos), California CPT-1 certified (License #CPT-02356928), ER background. Second phlebotomist on the team: Lila.
- Phone / text: (707) 280-3651
- Email (clinics and care facilities): mariposaphlebotomymobile@gmail.com
- Booking: https://mariposamobilephlebotomy.as.me
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 3pm, Saturday 8am to 11am
- Based in Rohnert Park, CA 94928. Mobile service only, no walk-in location: phlebotomists travel to the client.
- HIPAA compliant, fully insured
- Same-day and next-day availability
- Autism-informed, sensory-aware pediatric care available

## Services and prices (every price covers the visit, the draw, labeling, and delivery to the lab or carrier)
- Standard home blood draw: $200
- Pediatric draw: $200 to $250. Autism-informed care add-on: +$25 (pre-visit planning call and extra time)
- Therapeutic phlebotomy (unit draws for hemochromatosis, polycythemia vera, and other provider orders; standing orders accepted): $250 per draw
- Galleri test blood draw (multi-cancer early detection kit; kit handling and same-day carrier drop-off included): $175
- Other mail-in kits (InsideTracker, Function Health, Genova, Boston Heart, and similar): standard draw rate, kit handling included
- Athlete performance packages (fasted early-morning draw plus panel): Baseline $450, Performance $550, Complete $700
- Workplace, clinic, and care-facility visits: group pricing by email
- Superbills provided for out-of-network insurance reimbursement. Insurance and Medicare are not billed directly.
- Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before the appointment; a $50 visit fee applies inside 24 hours or if the draw cannot go ahead.

## Labs and orders
- Samples are delivered to Quest, LabCorp, and hospital labs across the service area.
- Orders accepted as a printed copy, in MyChart or another patient portal, or faxed by the provider's office.

## Service area
Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Solano, and Sacramento counties, plus the greater San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, San Mateo).

## Reviews
5.0 from 54 Google reviews. Clients consistently describe the phlebotomists (Ellie and Lila) as prompt, gentle, professional, and great with children. Read more on the Google Business Profile: search "Mariposa Mobile Phlebotomy Rohnert Park".
